name: Jarvis Schedule
description: Runs recurring scheduled missions: define a briefing, workspace, time window and optional squad, and every day at that time the plugin dispatches a fully autonomous mission into ADE, keeping a history of each dispatch and the data the maestro returned. Ships its own local web dashboard.
author: Vidiio

settings.label: ADE SaaS Bridge URL
settings.description: Only for older ADE versions (ignored when ADE provides the Bridge automatically). Base URL of the local ADE SaaS Bridge, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4820

settings.label: ADE SaaS Bridge token
settings.description: Only for older ADE versions. ADE 0.4.0+ starts the Bridge for this plugin and hands over its address and token automatically, so leave this empty. Older ADE needs ADE_BRIDGE=1 and the Bridge token here.

settings.label: Dashboard port
settings.description: Local port (127.0.0.1 only) where the schedule dashboard is served

settings.label: Dashboard token
settings.description: Optional. Only needed to open the dashboard in a regular browser (you type it on the login screen; at least 12 characters). Inside ADE the Agendamentos screen signs in by itself. It protects a dashboard that can start real missions.

settings.label: Default timezone
settings.description: IANA timezone proposed for new schedules, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo

settings.label: History retention (days)
settings.description: How many days of dispatch history to keep before pruning

settings.label: Scheduler enabled
settings.description: Master switch. When off, no schedule fires automatically (the dashboard stays available and manual runs still work).

integrations.name: Jarvis Schedule
integrations.description: Scheduler + local dashboard that dispatches recurring missions through the ADE SaaS Bridge
